sections.description: Site Based Activity Log Viewing and Settings Manager for MainWP
sections.installation:
1. Upload the `mainwp-activity-log-ext` folder to the `/wp-content/plugins/` directory.
2. Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' menu in WordPress.
3. Configure the plugin settings it is located in the Simply Static Menu
sections.frequently_asked_questions:
= How do I modify the settings =
Navigate to the site you want to modify and on the sitetab select activity log
